purpose: This medicine is used to treat malaria, a serious infection spread by mosquito bites. It works against a specific type of malaria parasite called Plasmodium falciparum. Your doctor will prescribe it when you have been diagnosed with malaria and need treatment.
how_it_works: This medication is actually two medicines working together as a team to fight the malaria parasite in your blood. Artemether attacks and kills the parasite very quickly, while lumefantrine stays in your body longer to wipe out any remaining parasites. Together, they are much more effective than either medicine would be on its own.
common_side_effects: You may feel headache, dizziness, or tiredness. Some people feel sick to their stomach, have stomach pain, or lose their appetite. You might also notice muscle aches, chills, or have trouble sleeping. These side effects are usually mild and get better as your body fights the infection.
warnings: Always take this medicine with food, especially something fatty like milk or a full meal, because food helps your body absorb it properly. Do not take it if you are allergic to either ingredient. Tell your doctor if you have heart problems, since this medicine can affect your heart rhythm. Pregnant women in their first trimester should talk to their doctor before taking it. Do not use it for prevention of malaria — it is only for treating malaria you already have.
typical_dosing: Adults and children over 35 kg usually take 4 tablets twice a day for 3 days — that is a total of 6 doses. Children receive smaller doses based on their weight. It is very important to take all 6 doses even if you start feeling better, to make sure all the parasites are gone. Always take each dose with food or a fatty drink like milk.
